raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #44745.

A streamed client can disconnect and release its tokenizer reader lock while its request is still active in the scheduler. `pause_generation(mode="abort")` previously returned success as soon as that lock was free, although the abort was fire-and-forget and scheduler cleanup was incomplete. An immediate `release_memory_occupation` then hit its idle assertion and killed the scheduler.

## Modifications

- Add an internal scheduler-idle probe using the existing fan-out communicator.
- In abort-mode pause, wait for both the tokenizer reader lock to clear and every scheduler replica to report `is_fully_idle()`.
- Keep scheduler inference enabled during the wait so normal abort cleanup, including overlap results, can drain. Retain the memory-release idle assertion.
- Share the abort drain helper between TokenizerManager and the multi-HTTP-worker override, so both paths wait for scheduler cleanup.
- Shield each in-flight probe from caller cancellation and retain it in the manager task set. The existing communicator FIFO lock stays held until all replies drain, preventing stale replies from satisfying a retry.
- Add seven CPU regression tests covering disconnect cleanup, all-replica idle checks, tokenizer readers, other pause modes, the full-idle predicate, multi-HTTP-worker pause, and cancellation/retry with delayed responses from two scheduler replicas.

## Reproduction and validation

Tested upstream base `a038a0dca05cefca1e0edc4ac43e3bfbec2e064c` and the patch on one NVIDIA A10 (23 GB), using `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B`, CUDA 13.0 / PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, and the reporter's unmodified stdlib repro script from #44745.

Server:
```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --port 30000 \
  --enable-memory-saver --max-total-tokens 6000 --max-running-requests 32
python3 repro.py http://127.0.0.1:30000
```

The runtime used `lmsysorg/sglang:dev` (digest `sha256:0b3e39704480c423d8a00ca15ebee63154defc62944df2d4b11c594563bab457`) with the source checkout mounted, FlashInfer updated from 0.7.1 to the source-required 0.7.2, and the image's bundled Rust tree-core extension copied into the checkout. Default overlap scheduling and the Rust tree core were enabled.

| Run | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Unmodified baseline | Trial 0: pause HTTP 200, release HTTP 500, server down; scheduler raised the reported idle assertion |
| Patched, original repro | 10/10 trials passed, alternating 0 ms and 1 ms after disconnect; every pause/release/resume/continue returned HTTP 200 and health remained HTTP 200 |

Baseline scheduler exception:
```text
File ".../scheduler_components/weight_updater.py", line 339, in release_memory_occupation
    assert self.is_fully_idle(
AssertionError: release_memory_occupation should be called only when server is idle.
SIGQUIT received. signum=None, frame=None. It usually means one child failed.
```

Patched repro:
```text
trial 0: pause(abort) 0 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
trial 1: pause(abort) 1 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
trial 2: pause(abort) 0 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
trial 3: pause(abort) 1 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
trial 4: pause(abort) 0 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
trial 5: pause(abort) 1 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
trial 6: pause(abort) 0 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
trial 7: pause(abort) 1 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
trial 8: pause(abort) 0 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
trial 9: pause(abort) 1 ms after the disconnect -> pause 200, release 200, resume 200, continue 200; alive
not reproduced
```

Regression command:
```bash
python3 -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_abort_pause_idle.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_pause_generation.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_tokenizer_manager_rid_cleanup.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_multi_tokenizer_mixin.py
```
Result after the edge-case fixes: **104 passed, 51 subtests passed** (20 dependency/configuration warnings).

The original GPU repro was rerun against commit `53d1442141979fcdfa28410ad7ca909610e356af`:

| Configuration | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Default single HTTP worker | 10/10 trials passed; all control calls HTTP 200, health HTTP 200 |
| `--tokenizer-worker-num 2` | 10/10 trials passed; all control calls HTTP 200, health HTTP 200 |

Both runs used the unchanged reporter script, alternating 0 ms and 1 ms disconnect delays. Multi-HTTP-worker validation uses two HTTP/tokenizer workers on the same A10; it is not multi-GPU validation.

Multi-GPU and disaggregated runtime validation were not performed; the all-replica wait is covered by a unit test.

## Accuracy Tests

No model-forward or sampling changes. The end-to-end repro verifies generation can continue after memory resume; no separate accuracy benchmark was run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No throughput benchmark was run. Scheduler-idle polling occurs only during abort-mode pause, with a 10 ms delay between unsuccessful probes.

## Checklist

- [x] Add CPU regression tests and register them for CPU CI.
- [x] Reproduce the baseline crash and rerun the original GPU repro with the patch.
- [ ] Upstream CI and multi-GPU/disaggregated validation.

+import asyncio
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.communicator import FanOutCommunicator
+from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import (
+    GetSchedulerIdleReqInput,
+    GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput,
+    PauseGenerationReqInput,
+)
+from sglang.srt.managers.multi_tokenizer_mixin import TokenizerWorker
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager import TokenizerManager
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=12, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestAbortPauseIdle(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
+    def manager(self):
+        manager = SimpleNamespace(
+            is_pause_cond=asyncio.Condition(),
+            asyncio_tasks=set(),
+            model_update_lock=SimpleNamespace(is_locked=AsyncMock(return_value=False)),
+            abort_request=Mock(),
+            auto_create_handle_loop=Mock(),
+            get_scheduler_idle_communicator=AsyncMock(),
+            _async_dispatch_to_scheduler=AsyncMock(),
+        )
+
+        manager._abort_requests_and_wait_for_idle = lambda: (
+            TokenizerManager._abort_requests_and_wait_for_idle(manager)
+        )
+        return manager
+
+    async def test_disconnected_handler_does_not_imply_scheduler_idle(self):
+        manager = self.manager()
+        probe_started = asyncio.Event()
+        scheduler_drained = asyncio.Event()
+
+        async def probe(req):
+            self.assertIsInstance(req, GetSchedulerIdleReqInput)
+            probe_started.set()
+            await scheduler_drained.wait()
+            return [GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True)]
+
+        manager.get_scheduler_idle_communicator.side_effect = probe
+        task = asyncio.create_task(
+            TokenizerManager.pause_generation(manager, PauseGenerationReqInput())
+        )
+        try:
+            await asyncio.wait_for(probe_started.wait(), timeout=2)
+            self.assertFalse(task.done())
+            manager.abort_request.assert_called_once_with(abort_all=True)
+            scheduler_drained.set()
+            await asyncio.wait_for(task, timeout=2)
+        finally:
+            if not task.done():
+                task.cancel()
+                await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
+
+    async def test_all_scheduler_replicas_must_drain(self):
+        manager = self.manager()
+        manager.get_scheduler_idle_communicator.side_effect = [
+            [
+                GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True),
+                GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=False),
+            ],
+            [
+                GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True),
+                GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True),
+            ],
+        ]
+        await TokenizerManager.pause_generation(manager, PauseGenerationReqInput())
+        self.assertEqual(manager.get_scheduler_idle_communicator.await_count, 2)
+
+    async def test_tokenizer_reader_must_also_finish(self):
+        manager = self.manager()
+        manager.model_update_lock.is_locked.side_effect = [True, False]
+        manager.get_scheduler_idle_communicator.return_value = [
+            GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True)
+        ]
+        await TokenizerManager.pause_generation(manager, PauseGenerationReqInput())
+        self.assertEqual(manager.get_scheduler_idle_communicator.await_count, 2)
+
+    async def test_other_pause_modes_do_not_wait_for_idle(self):
+        for mode in ("in_place", "retract"):
+            manager = self.manager()
+            req = PauseGenerationReqInput(mode=mode)
+            await TokenizerManager.pause_generation(manager, req)
+            manager._async_dispatch_to_scheduler.assert_awaited_once_with(req)
+            manager.get_scheduler_idle_communicator.assert_not_awaited()
+
+    async def test_multi_http_worker_waits_for_scheduler_cleanup(self):
+        manager = self.manager()
+        probe_started = asyncio.Event()
+        drained = asyncio.Event()
+
+        def broadcast(req):
+            manager._pause_continue_future.set_result(True)
+
+        async def probe(req):
+            probe_started.set()
+            await drained.wait()
+            return [GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True)]
+
+        manager._dispatch_to_scheduler = broadcast
+        manager.get_scheduler_idle_communicator.side_effect = probe
+        task = asyncio.create_task(
+            TokenizerWorker.pause_generation(manager, PauseGenerationReqInput())
+        )
+        try:
+            await asyncio.wait_for(probe_started.wait(), 2)
+            self.assertFalse(task.done())
+            drained.set()
+            await asyncio.wait_for(task, 2)
+        finally:
+            drained.set()
+            task.cancel()
+            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
+
+    async def test_cancelled_probe_drains_before_next_pause(self):
+        manager = self.manager()
+        sent = asyncio.Queue()
+        communicator = FanOutCommunicator(sent.put_nowait, fan_out=2)
+        manager.get_scheduler_idle_communicator = communicator
+        first = asyncio.create_task(
+            TokenizerManager.pause_generation(manager, PauseGenerationReqInput())
+        )
+        second = None
+        try:
+            await asyncio.wait_for(sent.get(), 2)
+            first.cancel()
+            await asyncio.gather(first, return_exceptions=True)
+            second = asyncio.create_task(
+                TokenizerManager.pause_generation(manager, PauseGenerationReqInput())
+            )
+            await asyncio.sleep(0)
+            # Replies to the cancelled pause must drain before a new probe is sent.
+            communicator.handle_recv(GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True))
+            await asyncio.sleep(0)
+            self.assertTrue(sent.empty())
+            self.assertFalse(second.done())
+            communicator.handle_recv(GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True))
+            await asyncio.wait_for(sent.get(), 2)
+            await asyncio.sleep(0)
+            self.assertFalse(second.done())
+            # A non-idle answer to the new probe must cause another round.
+            communicator.handle_recv(GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=False))
+            communicator.handle_recv(GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True))
+            await asyncio.wait_for(sent.get(), 2)
+            communicator.handle_recv(GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True))
+            communicator.handle_recv(GetSchedulerIdleReqOutput(is_idle=True))
+            await asyncio.wait_for(second, 2)
+        finally:
+            for task in (first, second, *manager.asyncio_tasks):
+                if task is not None:
+                    task.cancel()
+            await asyncio.gather(
+                *(
+                    task
+                    for task in (first, second, *manager.asyncio_tasks)
+                    if task is not None
+                ),
+                return_exceptions=True,
+            )
+
+    def test_scheduler_reports_full_idle_predicate(self):
+        scheduler = SimpleNamespace(is_fully_idle=Mock(return_value=False))
+        self.assertFalse(
+            Scheduler.get_scheduler_idle(scheduler, GetSchedulerIdleReqInput()).is_idle
+        )
+        scheduler.is_fully_idle.return_value = True
+        self.assertTrue(
+            Scheduler.get_scheduler_idle(scheduler, GetSchedulerIdleReqInput()).is_idle
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
